channel.title: Solidarity Magazine – Bias and Credibility - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from Solidarity Magazine – Bias and Credibility (solidarity.net.au)

item.title: Trump’s plans for Gaza—occupy and plunder – Solidarity Online
item.description: The first meeting of Donald Trump’s Gaza “Board of Peace” was held on 19 February. It was a sickening gathering of war criminals and plunderers, meeting to discuss their nightmarish plans for a post-war Gaza.

item.title: UWU members speak out on what’s at stake in the union election – Solidarity Online
item.description: Solidarity spoke with United Workers Union members about the current union election

item.title: Which way forward for the UWU? ‘We need to take control of our union’ – Solidarity Online
item.description: The first contested election for Australia’s biggest blue-collar union, the United Workers Union, has become the focus of an intense debate about the way forward for the union.

item.title: One Nation a threat as right-wing Labor dominates in SA election – Solidarity Online
item.description: The 21 March state election in South Australia sees a confident Labor government likely to increase its majority. It is also the first major test of whether Pauline Hanson’s racist One Nation can replace a weak Liberal Party as the dominant force on the right.

item.title: Labor fans Islamophobia as One Nation surges – Solidarity Online
item.description: One Nation is surfing a wave of anger and disillusionment with the major parties. Much of that momentum is fuelled by the cost-of-living crisis—but the party is also fomenting Islamophobia to harden up its supporters.

item.title: Palestine supporters assaulted and kicked out of Mardi Gras – Solidarity Online
item.description: Supporters of Palestine were banned from this year’s Mardi Gras parade and thrown off floats by police, continuing the climate of repression created by NSW Premier Chris Minns’ anti-protest laws.

item.title: Defiance needed to new laws meant to silence Palestine solidarity – Solidarity Online
item.description: Two protesters in Queensland were arrested for using the slogan “From the River to the Sea” at a rally on 11 March—the day new laws that ban the phrase came into effect. One of them now faces charges which carry the threat of two years’ jail.

item.title: Why we need to defy ban on Globalise the Intifada – Solidarity Online
item.description: The Minns government in NSW is attempting to ban the phrase “Globalise the Intifada”, with Victorian Premier Jacinta Allan also saying she hopes to prosecute people using it.

item.title: Albanese joins Trump’s war in Iran—time to break the US alliance – Solidarity Online
item.description: Donald Trump has unleashed weeks of savage bombing of Iran, threatening “death, fire and fury” as the regime refuses to capitulate.

item.title: ‘21 and nothing’ triggers strike at Curtin Uni – Solidarity Online
item.description: “Twenty one and nothing”: this was one of the reproaches that was directed at management at the Curtin University as staff held a 24 hour strike on Monday.
